question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Stout
solution:
The correct answer is "**Thin**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the** meaning **of the given word.

 
 
• **Stout**: (of a person) rather fat or of heavy build.
 
 
 
• ​Let's look at the **meaning **of the given words.
 
 
• ​**Obese**: grossly fat or overweight.
 
• **Heavy**: of great weight; difficult to lift or move.
 
• **Thin**: having little, or too little, flesh or fat on the body.
 
• **Bulky**: (of a person) heavily built.
 
 
 
• ​As per the meaning of the given words, "**thin**" is the antonym of the word "stout".
 
 
• ​**Example**: *Abhishek used to be such a **thin **__and lanky fellow in his teenage years*.
 
 

​Hence, the correct answer is **option 3**.
